description_en: Activates a Tair Serverless KV workspace instance
description_zh: 用于开通一个Tair Serverless KV的workspace实例
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore create-tair-skv-ddb-workspace --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-e --instance-type tair_skv_ddb_ws --vpc-id vpc-bp1nme44gek34slfc00 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d00 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTairSkvDdbWorkspace

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can contain up to 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html to query available regions. Use this parameter to specify the region in which to create the instance
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html查询，使用此参数指定要创建实例的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473764.html to query available zones
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type. Set the value to tair_skv_ddb_ws
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The instance name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. The name cannot contain the following characters: @ / : = " < > { } or spaces
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称。 名称为2-128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，不支持字符@/:="<>{}和空格
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the instance. The password must meet the following requirements:
The password is 8 to 32 characters in length.
The password contains at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. Supported special characters are `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.help_zh:
实例密码，需满足下述要求：
长度为8~32位。
需包含大写字母、小写字母、特殊字符和数字中的至少三种，支持的特殊字符为`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC)
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The service port of the instance. Valid values: 1 to 65535. Default value: 443
parameters.help_zh: 实例的服务端口，取值范围：1~65535，默认值为 443
parameters.name: port

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth limit of the instance. Unit: MB/s

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

`PrePaid`: subscription.
`PostPaid`: pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型，返回值：

`PrePaid`：预付费。
`PostPaid`：按量付费

Config.description_en: The detailed configuration of the instance

ConnectionDomain.description_en: The internal endpoint of the Redis instance

Connections.description_en: The maximum number of connections supported by the instance

InstanceStatus.description_en: The current status of the instance. The return value is fixed as Creating
InstanceStatus.description_zh: 实例的当前状态，返回值固定为 Creating（创建中）

QPS.description_en: The queries per second (QPS). This value is the theoretical value for the current instance specifications
QPS.description_zh: 每秒访问次数，此处为当前规格实例的理论值

RegionId.description_en: The region in which the instance resides

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the task flow that is executed for the creation

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the instance
